subject: Error in rsconnect::appDependencies() ==> impossible to publish on shinyapps.io

messages.author: 622cb9e21df317e9
messages.subject: Error in rsconnect::appDependencies() ==> impossible to publish on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hello everyone,

I've build a shiny app that works perfectly locally, but when I try to publish it on my shinyapps.io account it systematically failed (both calling the rsconnect::deployApp() and using the Publish button in RStudio).
The app is mainly using the tabulizer package to extract table from pdf (extract_tables() function).
I tried to publish another application which uses basic packages and it worked, meaning that I might have issue with the tabulizer package dependencies?
The output of rsconnect::appDependencies() is : Error in vapply(packages, function(pkg) { : values must be length 1, but FUN(X[[29]]) result is length 0. The same error message is appearing when I try to publish, stopping at the Bundling step.

Is the tabulizer package not compatible with shinyapps.io? Any ideas?
Note that I downloaded all the packages using devtools::install_github().

Thanks a lot.
Raphael B.
